$comment: The deploy ladder. Single source of truth for where code goes live. Read by .claude skills, agents and loops -- adding a rung is a config entry here, not a code change. See CLAUDE.md section 'The ladder'.

local.label: Local
local.notes: Vite dev server. A custom directoryIndexRedirect plugin makes /foo resolve to /foo/index.html the way a static host would.

preview.label: Preview
preview.notes: Throwaway, one per topic. Fast lane -- sloppy code is allowed here on purpose. WARNING: preview.yml uses destination_dir: preview/${{ github.ref_name }} and ref_name already contains the slash, so branch preview/foo publishes to /preview/preview/foo/. The /deploy skill strips the prefix so the URL above is the real one; if you push by hand you get the doubled path.

stage.label: Stage
stage.notes: The integrator's cherry-pick workbench, not a shared branch. ONE persistent URL. Contributors develop on long-lived branches; the integrator picks commits from those onto 'stage', makes them production-ready, and releases. stage-reset.yml hard-resets it to main every night, so stage is DERIVED STATE and nothing here is precious -- force-pushing it is correct. See DECISIONS.md ADR-018. A single branch named 'stage', not the legacy stage/** pattern that preview.yml still matches.

prod.label: Production
prod.notes: deploy.yml has NO push trigger. A direct commit to main deploys nothing. Production publishes only when a PR to main is closed-as-merged, or on manual workflow_dispatch. Merging the PR IS the deploy button.

pages.$comment: Routing is the filesystem: vite.config.js globs **/*.html into rollupOptions.input. This list is for skills that need to enumerate routes; verify against dist/ after a build rather than trusting it.

concurrency.$comment: All workflows that write gh-pages MUST join this group. One branch, many destination_dirs, keep_files: true, never cancel a write.
